answer: Put light client proof of Stellar state at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 404 aliases need 404 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. What carries the willow here is verification, the nebula of cost is what stops the farm, and the kernel of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
